profile.headline: Systems Software Engineer at Green Hills Software
profile.summary:
In May 2024, I graduated from the University of Florida with a dual degree in Computer Engineering and Mathematics. Following my graduation, I began a position as a Systems Software Engineer for the Safety and Security Critical Products Division of Green Hills Software.

My interests include embedded software and operating systems. My role as an undergraduate teaching assistant for Microprocessor Applications allowed me to foster my passion for embedded software engineering. I have also completed a second course on the subject that focuses on real-time operating system development. I continue to enrich my knowledge as I develop software verification code for the INTEGRITY-178 tuMP RTOS.
